summary_en: Presents an integrated spherical-array platform that performs real-time 3D tomographic optoacoustic imaging while concurrently delivering focused ultrasound. The system enables target localization and online monitoring of lesion formation, with ex-vivo mouse-brain and in-vivo sheep experiments validated by MRI and histology.
